stack_name: LangGraph / CrewAI / AutoGen / OpenAI Agents SDK (paired with wallets)
speaks_to: You are a LangGraph graph, a CrewAI crew, an AutoGen chat loop, or an OpenAI Agents SDK agent that gained payment capability by pairing with AgentKit / Openfort / Crossmint / Privy / Turnkey. Read this before a payment node fires with no exit condition.

wallet_capability.wallet_type: provider-agnostic — wallet/signer supplied by AgentKit, Openfort, Crossmint, Privy, or Turnkey; the framework only dispatches the tool

payment_call_mechanism.how_agent_calls_paid_tools: Payment tools (transfer_funds, pay_x402, sign_transaction) are registered as callable functions. The LLM calls one by name with arguments; the framework dispatches to the wallet provider API; on success the tool returns a receipt or tx hash, which is passed to the next node/agent/tool. LangGraph: graph nodes + edges + checkpoints. CrewAI: role-based with task-level error boundaries. AutoGen: conversational retry. OpenAI Agents SDK: handoff-based, needs an explicit MAX_TOOL_CALLS / step budget.
payment_call_mechanism.payment_auth_method: inherited from the paired wallet provider
payment_call_mechanism.facilitator: depends on paired provider (e.g. Coinbase CDP x402 Facilitator)

expected_x402_flow: LLM calls a registered payment tool by name with arguments
Framework validates arguments (Pydantic/Zod) and dispatches to the wallet provider
Provider signs/executes; tool returns a receipt or transaction hash
Receipt is serialized into graph checkpoint / crew state / conversation and passed to the next step
On a sub-agent handoff, wallet context must survive serialization (LangGraph checkpoint, CrewAI crew, AutoGen conversation boundary)

spend_policy_assumptions.note: These frameworks ship no native spend cap. LangGraph without a step budget on a payment node loops infinitely; AutoGen retries the payment tool conversationally; CrewAI reassigns the failed payment task to the same tool. Under context pressure the LLM drops required payment fields (FM-02), and a 'payment confirmed' message may be hallucinated with no tool call behind it (FM-08).

primary_failure_mode.description: Under context pressure the LLM generates malformed payment-tool arguments; Pydantic/Zod validation fires; the agent re-invokes with the same malformed args. A documented production loop pattern.
primary_failure_mode.payment_consequence: The payment tool never executes; the agent may hallucinate success (FM-08) or loop until the run budget is exhausted.

observable_trigger_signals.signal: Step count per run spikes with no output improvement
Clusters of 3+ calls to the same payment tool with incrementally different args / repeated 4xx
Agent message confirms 'payment sent' but the tool-call log shows no call
LangGraph payment node has no error_edge defined → missing recovery path in the graph spec
Payment fields dropped at high token counts
observable_trigger_signals.source: tool args vs. schema at high context

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: the same payment tool keeps failing validation / 4xx and you are re-invoking
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: distress_class schema_mismatch / loop_detected + the next pack + stop/preserve/continue

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: a payment tool keeps failing Pydantic/Zod argument validation and you know the problem is the schema
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: named repair_class + a deterministic fix recipe (or schema_poisoning/unreachable flag) so the re-invoke is not identical

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: token count is high and payment fields are starting to drop from tool args
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: a band (headroom/compact/stop-and-compact/critical) + the next_call before context loss corrupts the payment intent

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: step count is climbing with no progress on a payment node
you are about to record/propagate a 'payment confirmed' state
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: verify the payment claim against the actual tool log before downstream agents act

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: you fired a settlement and are unsure it confirmed before serializing the receipt
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: verdict confirmed/pending/failed/already_fulfilled so the next node does not double-pay or proceed on a hallucinated receipt

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: a checkpoint/handoff just deserialized without wallet context
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: wiring/handoff context check before the sub-agent attempts to sign

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: a mistake on a payment node is compounding across the graph
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: break the cascade before more nodes pay on bad state

priority_rationale: LangGraph has the most deterministic recovery surface (explicit edges, checkpoints) and the highest enterprise deployment; CrewAI and AutoGen need more prompt-level guardrails; the OpenAI Agents SDK's reported GPT-5 tool-call breakage is an active signal. FM-02 schema-mismatch loops under context pressure dominate.
